description: What a bonus check pays after the flat 22% federal supplemental withholding, FICA and state tax, and how much of the federal withholding comes back (or is still owed) at tax time, on top of a salary, 2026 rules (IRS Pub. 15).

salary.description: Annual gross salary in dollars. Give this or hourly_rate.

state.description: Two-letter state code or name: TX, CA, new-york, DC.

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2026 or 2027. Default: the year in force today (2026 now; 2027 from January 1, 2027).
